summary: End-to-end deployment readiness validation for Keneth Global e-commerce (React + FastAPI + MongoDB + Stripe Flow B). Ran full pytest suite (42/42 passing) and Playwright UI flows against public preview URL. Backend: health/products/verticals/product-by-slug/checkout/webhook/auth/admin/wishlist/journal/wholesale all pass; server-side price computation verified; ObjectId leak checked; role-based access enforced. Frontend: home, shop, product detail (royal-garam-masala), Add to Cart, guest checkout redirect to checkout.stripe.com (€8.90 sandbox page rendered), SPA deep-link on /shop and /product/:slug (no 404), admin login (admin@kenethglobal.com) reaches /account with stats (Revenue/Orders 6/Products 21/Customers 6), customer register stores kg_token and /auth/me returns 200, language switcher toggles EN/DE/FR (verified translated UI copy).

issues: Revenue tile renders '₹0' (INR rupee sign) instead of '€0' — store currency is EUR everywhere else. Formatter/locale mismatch in admin stats card.
Ticker text ('Complimentary EU delivery over €120 / Sealed within hours of milling / Handcrafted in six Indian states') is hard-coded English and does not translate when switching to DE/FR/ES/IT.

action_items: Admin dashboard revenue card: replace INR '₹' formatter with EUR '€' (or use Intl.NumberFormat('de-DE',{style:'currency',currency:'EUR'})).
Localize the top marquee/announcement bar strings via the i18n dictionary so DE/FR/ES/IT visitors see translated messaging.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS middleware is added AFTER include_router; FastAPI still applies it, but conventional order is add middleware before mounting routers to avoid surprises with future middlewares.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan context (FastAPI >=0.109).

seed_catalog runs unconditionally on every startup and overwrites editorial fields (names/descriptions/prices) — will silently revert any admin PATCH to price_eur on next boot. Consider gating with an env flag or checking a version key.

/api/checkout/session builds webhook_url from client-supplied origin_url (payload.origin_url). In production this should be pinned to a server-side env (PUBLIC_BASE_URL) so a malicious client can't influence webhook routing.
extra_routes.py and image_gen.py were not opened here; recommend a quick scan for the same _id-leak / auth patterns.

If catalog changes further, only test_filter_by_vertical/category counts (6/6/5, blended-spices=3) may need adjustment. Public URL: https://fullstack-shop-test.preview.emergentagent.com. rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Two minor design gaps identified: (1) admin revenue card uses INR '₹' glyph — likely a leftover from an INR-branded prototype; symbol should be '€' since amounts are EUR (backend returns revenue_eur). (2) Announcement marquee is a static string, not routed through i18n dictionary; add keys to /app/frontend/src/constants (or wherever the LanguageContext dictionary lives) and read via useTranslation().
